verdict.rationale: Feitian documents NFC as a FIDO interface: MultiPass supports USB, NFC and BLE, and any of them can be used to complete U2F registration and authentication. It also sells a "USB + NFC security key for login on PC and Android," and offers an Android management app (iePassManager), so tap-to-authenticate on Android phones is clearly claimed. Missing for 10: any evidence of NFC on iOS (iOS is only mentioned for Bluetooth and Lightning), specific mobile browser or app walkthroughs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NFC mobile logins.
